notes: v1.10.3 - A plugin turned on mid-session now fills straight away: enabling, reloading or updating a plugin while connected used to leave its panels empty until the next login, because most of the 3Scapes GMCP feed (Guild.Kingdom, Guild.Roster, Merc.* ...) is sent as a full report at login and only changes after that. Scrye now keeps what each package's current picture is built from and replays it to the plugin as it loads; chat and kill messages are never replayed.
